```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE, fig.width = 8, fig.height = 5)

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(ggplot2)
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(DT)
  library(plotly)
})

theme_set(theme_minimal(base_size = 14))

# Read data
summary_df <- read.delim(params$summary_file, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
detail_df <- read.delim(params$detail_file, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
params_df <- read.delim(params$params_file, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# Read coverage data if available (run-length encoded intervals)
has_coverage <- nchar(params$coverage_file) > 0 && file.exists(params$coverage_file)
if (has_coverage) {
  coverage_intervals <- read.delim(params$coverage_file, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
}

# Read species calls if available (from --identify step)
has_species_calls <- nchar(params$species_calls_file) > 0 && file.exists(params$species_calls_file)
if (has_species_calls) {
  species_calls <- read.delim(params$species_calls_file, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
}

# Convert interval-format coverage to plottable points for a single reference.
# For small references (<=max_points positions) expands to per-position data.
# For large references, bins intervals into at most max_points summary points.
# Input: data frame with columns start, end, depth (for one reference_id)
# Output: data frame with columns reference_id, position, depth
expand_intervals <- function(interval_df, max_points = 2000) {
  if (nrow(interval_df) == 0) {
    return(data.frame(reference_id = character(), position = integer(), depth = numeric()))
  }
  ref_id <- interval_df$reference_id[1]
  total_len <- max(interval_df$end) - min(interval_df$start) + 1L

  if (total_len <= max_points) {
    # Small reference: expand fully
    positions <- unlist(mapply(seq, interval_df$start, interval_df$end, SIMPLIFY = FALSE))
    depths <- rep(interval_df$depth, interval_df$end - interval_df$start + 1L)
    return(data.frame(reference_id = ref_id, position = positions, depth = depths))
  }

  # Large reference: bin intervals into max_points bins
  genome_start <- min(interval_df$start)
  genome_end <- max(interval_df$end)
  bin_size <- (genome_end - genome_start + 1) / max_points
  bin_edges <- genome_start + bin_size * (0:max_points)

  bin_depth_sum <- numeric(max_points)
  bin_width <- numeric(max_points)

  for (i in seq_len(nrow(interval_df))) {
    iv_start <- interval_df$start[i]
    iv_end   <- interval_df$end[i]
    iv_depth <- interval_df$depth[i]
    # Find which bins this interval overlaps
    first_bin <- max(1L, ceiling((iv_start - genome_start) / bin_size))
    last_bin  <- min(max_points, ceiling((iv_end - genome_start) / bin_size))
    if (first_bin > max_points || last_bin < 1L) next
    first_bin <- max(1L, first_bin)
    last_bin  <- min(max_points, last_bin)
    for (b in first_bin:last_bin) {
      overlap_start <- max(iv_start, bin_edges[b])
      overlap_end   <- min(iv_end, bin_edges[b + 1] - 1)
      overlap_len   <- overlap_end - overlap_start + 1
      if (overlap_len > 0) {
        bin_depth_sum[b] <- bin_depth_sum[b] + iv_depth * overlap_len
        bin_width[b]     <- bin_width[b] + overlap_len
      }
    }
  }

  avg_depth <- ifelse(bin_width > 0, bin_depth_sum / bin_width, 0)
  bin_centers <- (bin_edges[1:max_points] + bin_edges[2:(max_points + 1)]) / 2

  data.frame(reference_id = ref_id, position = bin_centers, depth = avg_depth)
}
```

```{r run-params}
# Helper to look up a parameter value
get_param <- function(name) {
  vals <- params_df$value[params_df$parameter == name]
  if (length(vals) == 0) return(NA_character_)
  paste(vals, collapse = ", ")
}

# Build parameters table (curated subset of key parameters)
param_table <- data.frame(
  Parameter = c("Targets", "Distractors", "Probes", "Sample",
                "Capture method", "Host filtering",
                "Num fragments", "Fragment length (mean/min/max)",
                "Read length", "Distractor fraction",
                "Min match bases", "Max mismatches", "Seed"),
  Value = c(
    basename(get_param("targets")),
    paste(basename(params_df$value[params_df$parameter == "distractors"]), collapse = ", "),
    basename(get_param("probes")),
    ifelse(get_param("sample") == "none", "all targets", basename(get_param("sample"))),
    get_param("capture_method"),
    ifelse(get_param("host_fasta") == "none", "none", basename(get_param("host_fasta"))),
    get_param("num_fragments"),
    sprintf("%s / %s / %s", get_param("fragment_length_mean"),
            get_param("fragment_length_min"), get_param("fragment_length_max")),
    get_param("read_length"),
    get_param("distractor_fraction"),
    get_param("min_match_bases"),
    get_param("max_mismatches"),
    ifelse(get_param("seed") == "none", "random", get_param("seed"))
  ),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

knitr::kable(param_table, align = "ll")
```

```{r command, results='asis'}
# Reconstruct the baitbench command from run_params.tsv.
# This is fully data-driven: new parameters added to run_params.tsv
# appear here automatically without any template changes.
cmd_parts <- c("baitbench run")
for (i in seq_len(nrow(params_df))) {
  flag <- params_df$flag[i]
  value <- params_df$value[i]
  # Skip parameters that were not set (optional params use "none")
  if (value == "none") next
  cmd_parts <- c(cmd_parts, sprintf("  %s %s", flag, value))
}
cat("```bash\n")
cat(paste(cmd_parts, collapse = " \\\n"), "\n")
cat("```\n")
```

## Pipeline Flow

```{r pipeline-flow-data, include=FALSE}
# --- Extract pipeline flow data ---
fragments_generated <- summary_df$fragments_generated
fragments_captured  <- summary_df$fragments_captured
not_captured        <- fragments_generated - fragments_captured

sample_generated            <- if ("sample_generated" %in% names(summary_df)) summary_df$sample_generated else 0
nonsample_target_generated  <- if ("nonsample_target_generated" %in% names(summary_df)) summary_df$nonsample_target_generated else 0
distractor_generated        <- if ("distractor_generated" %in% names(summary_df)) summary_df$distractor_generated else 0
untargeted_generated        <- if ("untargeted_generated" %in% names(summary_df)) summary_df$untargeted_generated else 0

sample_captured           <- summary_df$sample_captured
nonsample_target_captured <- summary_df$nonsample_target_captured
distractor_captured       <- summary_df$distractor_captured
untargeted_captured       <- if ("untargeted_captured" %in% names(summary_df)) summary_df$untargeted_captured else 0

sample_uncaptured            <- sample_generated - sample_captured
nonsample_target_uncaptured  <- nonsample_target_generated - nonsample_target_captured
distractor_uncaptured        <- distractor_generated - distractor_captured
untargeted_uncaptured        <- untargeted_generated - untargeted_captured

reads_sequenced    <- if ("reads_sequenced" %in% names(summary_df) && summary_df$reads_sequenced > 0) summary_df$reads_sequenced else 0
reads_after_filter <- if ("reads_after_filter" %in% names(summary_df) && summary_df$reads_after_filter > 0) summary_df$reads_after_filter else 0
reads_unmapped     <- if ("reads_unmapped" %in% names(summary_df)) summary_df$reads_unmapped else 0

reads_correctly_mapped   <- summary_df$reads_correctly_mapped
reads_incorrectly_mapped <- summary_df$reads_incorrectly_mapped

dist_frac <- as.numeric(get_param("distractor_fraction"))

# Conditional flags
has_sources        <- (sample_generated + distractor_generated + nonsample_target_generated + untargeted_generated) > 0
sequencing_changed <- (reads_sequenced > 0) && (reads_sequenced != fragments_captured)
filtering_applied  <- (reads_after_filter > 0)

sampling_loss <- if (sequencing_changed) fragments_captured - reads_sequenced else 0

if (filtering_applied) {
  pre_filter_count <- if (sequencing_changed) reads_sequenced else fragments_captured
  host_removed     <- pre_filter_count - reads_after_filter
} else {
  host_removed <- 0
}

# --- Formatting helpers ---
fmt <- function(n) format(n, big.mark = ",")
pct <- function(n, total) if (total > 0) sprintf("%.1f%%", n / total * 100) else "0.0%"

# --- Color palette ---
col_sample       <- "#27ae60"
col_nonsample    <- "#e67e22"
col_distractor   <- "#e74c3c"
col_untargeted   <- "#8e44ad"
col_generated    <- "#3498db"
col_captured     <- "#2ecc71"
col_not_captured <- "#c0392b"
col_correct      <- "#27ae60"
col_incorrect    <- "#e74c3c"
col_unmapped     <- "#95a5a6"
col_loss         <- "#e74c3c"
col_host_removed <- "#e74c3c"
col_filtered     <- "#2980b9"

rgba <- function(hex, alpha = 0.4) {
  r <- strtoi(substr(hex, 2, 3), 16)
  g <- strtoi(substr(hex, 4, 5), 16)
  b <- strtoi(substr(hex, 6, 7), 16)
  sprintf("rgba(%d,%d,%d,%.2f)", r, g, b, alpha)
}

# --- Sankey builder helpers ---
new_sankey <- function() {
  list(
    labels = character(), colors = character(),
    source = integer(), target = integer(), value = numeric(),
    link_color = character(), link_label = character()
  )
}

add_node <- function(sk, label, color) {
  idx <- length(sk$labels)  # 0-based
  sk$labels <- c(sk$labels, label)
  sk$colors <- c(sk$colors, color)
  list(sk = sk, idx = idx)
}

add_link <- function(sk, src, tgt, val, color, label = "") {
  if (val > 0) {
    sk$source     <- c(sk$source, src)
    sk$target     <- c(sk$target, tgt)
    sk$value      <- c(sk$value, val)
    sk$link_color <- c(sk$link_color, rgba(color))
    sk$link_label <- c(sk$link_label, label)
  }
  sk
}

render_sankey <- function(sk, height = 400) {
  plot_ly(
    type = "sankey", orientation = "h",
    arrangement = "freeform",
    valueformat = ",d",
    node = list(
      label = sk$labels, color = sk$colors,
      pad = 30, thickness = 25,
      line = list(color = "black", width = 1)
    ),
    link = list(
      source = sk$source, target = sk$target,
      value = sk$value, color = sk$link_color,
      label = sk$link_label
    )
  ) %>% layout(
    font = list(size = 12),
    paper_bgcolor = "white",
    margin = list(l = 10, r = 10, t = 10, b = 10)
  )
}
```

### Capture

```{r capture-sankey}
sk <- new_sankey()

# Source nodes (conditional)
if (has_sources) {
  if (sample_generated > 0) {
    res <- add_node(sk, sprintf("Sample Sources\n%s", fmt(sample_generated)), col_sample)
    sk <- res$sk; idx_sample_src <- res$idx
  }
  if (nonsample_target_generated > 0) {
    res <- add_node(sk, sprintf("Non-sample Sources\n%s", fmt(nonsample_target_generated)), col_nonsample)
    sk <- res$sk; idx_nonsample_src <- res$idx
  }
  if (distractor_generated > 0) {
    res <- add_node(sk, sprintf("Distractor Sources\n%s", fmt(distractor_generated)), col_distractor)
    sk <- res$sk; idx_distractor_src <- res$idx
  }
  if (untargeted_generated > 0) {
    res <- add_node(sk, sprintf("Untargeted Sources\n%s", fmt(untargeted_generated)), col_untargeted)
    sk <- res$sk; idx_untargeted_src <- res$idx
  }
}

# Generated node
res <- add_node(sk, sprintf("Generated\n%s", fmt(fragments_generated)), col_generated)
sk <- res$sk; idx_generated <- res$idx

# Capture outcome nodes
res <- add_node(sk, sprintf("Captured\n%s (%s)", fmt(fragments_captured), pct(fragments_captured, fragments_generated)), col_captured)
sk <- res$sk; idx_captured <- res$idx
res <- add_node(sk, sprintf("Not Captured\n%s (%s)", fmt(not_captured), pct(not_captured, fragments_generated)), col_not_captured)
sk <- res$sk; idx_not_captured <- res$idx

# Capture breakdown nodes
res <- add_node(sk, sprintf("Sample Captured\n%s", fmt(sample_captured)), col_sample)
sk <- res$sk; idx_sample_cap <- res$idx
if (nonsample_target_captured > 0) {
  res <- add_node(sk, sprintf("Non-sample Target\nCaptured %s", fmt(nonsample_target_captured)), col_nonsample)
  sk <- res$sk; idx_nonsample_cap <- res$idx
}
if (distractor_captured > 0) {
  res <- add_node(sk, sprintf("Distractor Captured\n%s", fmt(distractor_captured)), col_distractor)
  sk <- res$sk; idx_distractor_cap <- res$idx
}
if (untargeted_captured > 0) {
  res <- add_node(sk, sprintf("Untargeted Captured\n%s", fmt(untargeted_captured)), col_untargeted)
  sk <- res$sk; idx_untargeted_cap <- res$idx
}

# Uncaptured breakdown nodes
if (sample_uncaptured > 0) {
  res <- add_node(sk, sprintf("Sample Uncaptured\n%s", fmt(sample_uncaptured)), col_sample)
  sk <- res$sk; idx_sample_uncap <- res$idx
}
if (nonsample_target_uncaptured > 0) {
  res <- add_node(sk, sprintf("Non-sample Target\nUncaptured %s", fmt(nonsample_target_uncaptured)), col_nonsample)
  sk <- res$sk; idx_nonsample_uncap <- res$idx
}
if (distractor_uncaptured > 0) {
  res <- add_node(sk, sprintf("Distractor Uncaptured\n%s", fmt(distractor_uncaptured)), col_distractor)
  sk <- res$sk; idx_distractor_uncap <- res$idx
}
if (untargeted_uncaptured > 0) {
  res <- add_node(sk, sprintf("Untargeted Uncaptured\n%s", fmt(untargeted_uncaptured)), col_untargeted)
  sk <- res$sk; idx_untargeted_uncap <- res$idx
}

# Links: Sources -> Generated
if (has_sources) {
  if (sample_generated > 0) {
    sk <- add_link(sk, idx_sample_src, idx_generated, sample_generated, col_sample,
                   sprintf("Sample: %s", fmt(sample_generated)))
  }
  if (nonsample_target_generated > 0) {
    sk <- add_link(sk, idx_nonsample_src, idx_generated, nonsample_target_generated, col_nonsample,
                   sprintf("Non-sample target: %s", fmt(nonsample_target_generated)))
  }
  if (distractor_generated > 0) {
    sk <- add_link(sk, idx_distractor_src, idx_generated, distractor_generated, col_distractor,
                   sprintf("Distractor: %s", fmt(distractor_generated)))
  }
  if (untargeted_generated > 0) {
    sk <- add_link(sk, idx_untargeted_src, idx_generated, untargeted_generated, col_untargeted,
                   sprintf("Untargeted: %s", fmt(untargeted_generated)))
  }
}

# Links: Generated -> Capture outcome
sk <- add_link(sk, idx_generated, idx_captured, fragments_captured, col_captured,
               sprintf("Captured: %s", fmt(fragments_captured)))
sk <- add_link(sk, idx_generated, idx_not_captured, not_captured, col_not_captured,
               sprintf("Not captured: %s", fmt(not_captured)))

# Links: Captured -> Breakdown
sk <- add_link(sk, idx_captured, idx_sample_cap, sample_captured, col_sample,
               sprintf("Sample: %s", fmt(sample_captured)))
if (nonsample_target_captured > 0) {
  sk <- add_link(sk, idx_captured, idx_nonsample_cap, nonsample_target_captured, col_nonsample,
                 sprintf("Non-sample target: %s", fmt(nonsample_target_captured)))
}
if (distractor_captured > 0) {
  sk <- add_link(sk, idx_captured, idx_distractor_cap, distractor_captured, col_distractor,
                 sprintf("Distractor: %s", fmt(distractor_captured)))
}
if (untargeted_captured > 0) {
  sk <- add_link(sk, idx_captured, idx_untargeted_cap, untargeted_captured, col_untargeted,
                 sprintf("Untargeted: %s", fmt(untargeted_captured)))
}

# Links: Not Captured -> Breakdown
if (sample_uncaptured > 0) {
  sk <- add_link(sk, idx_not_captured, idx_sample_uncap, sample_uncaptured, col_sample,
                 sprintf("Sample: %s", fmt(sample_uncaptured)))
}
if (nonsample_target_uncaptured > 0) {
  sk <- add_link(sk, idx_not_captured, idx_nonsample_uncap, nonsample_target_uncaptured, col_nonsample,
                 sprintf("Non-sample target: %s", fmt(nonsample_target_uncaptured)))
}
if (distractor_uncaptured > 0) {
  sk <- add_link(sk, idx_not_captured, idx_distractor_uncap, distractor_uncaptured, col_distractor,
                 sprintf("Distractor: %s", fmt(distractor_uncaptured)))
}
if (untargeted_uncaptured > 0) {
  sk <- add_link(sk, idx_not_captured, idx_untargeted_uncap, untargeted_uncaptured, col_untargeted,
                 sprintf("Untargeted: %s", fmt(untargeted_uncaptured)))
}

render_sankey(sk, height = 380)
```

### Read Processing
-->
```{r mapping-sankey, results='asis', eval=FALSE}
if (fragments_captured == 0) {
  cat("*No fragments were captured. Downstream processing diagram omitted.*\n")
} else {
  sk <- new_sankey()

  # Starting node(s)
  if (sequencing_changed) {
    res <- add_node(sk, sprintf("Captured\n%s", fmt(fragments_captured)), col_captured)
    sk <- res$sk; idx_captured2 <- res$idx
    res <- add_node(sk, sprintf("Sequenced\n%s (%s)", fmt(reads_sequenced), pct(reads_sequenced, fragments_captured)), col_generated)
    sk <- res$sk; idx_input <- res$idx
    sk <- add_link(sk, idx_captured2, idx_input, reads_sequenced, col_generated,
                   sprintf("Sequenced: %s", fmt(reads_sequenced)))
    if (sampling_loss > 0) {
      res <- add_node(sk, sprintf("Sampling Loss\n%s (%s)", fmt(sampling_loss), pct(sampling_loss, fragments_captured)), col_loss)
      sk <- res$sk; idx_loss <- res$idx
      sk <- add_link(sk, idx_captured2, idx_loss, sampling_loss, col_loss,
                     sprintf("Sampling loss: %s", fmt(sampling_loss)))
    }
    input_count <- reads_sequenced
  } else {
    res <- add_node(sk, sprintf("Sequences\n%s", fmt(fragments_captured)), col_generated)
    sk <- res$sk; idx_input <- res$idx
    input_count <- fragments_captured
  }

  # Filtering (optional)
  if (filtering_applied) {
    res <- add_node(sk, sprintf("After Filter\n%s (%s)", fmt(reads_after_filter), pct(reads_after_filter, input_count)), col_filtered)
    sk <- res$sk; idx_filtered <- res$idx
    sk <- add_link(sk, idx_input, idx_filtered, reads_after_filter, col_filtered,
                   sprintf("After filter: %s", fmt(reads_after_filter)))
    if (host_removed > 0) {
      res <- add_node(sk, sprintf("Host Removed\n%s (%s)", fmt(host_removed), pct(host_removed, input_count)), col_host_removed)
      sk <- res$sk; idx_host <- res$idx
      sk <- add_link(sk, idx_input, idx_host, host_removed, col_host_removed,
                     sprintf("Host removed: %s", fmt(host_removed)))
    }
    idx_pre_map <- idx_filtered
    pre_map_count <- reads_after_filter
  } else {
    idx_pre_map <- idx_input
    pre_map_count <- input_count
  }

  # Mapping outcomes
  if (reads_correctly_mapped > 0) {
    res <- add_node(sk, sprintf("Correctly Mapped\n%s (%s)", fmt(reads_correctly_mapped), pct(reads_correctly_mapped, pre_map_count)), col_correct)
    sk <- res$sk; idx_correct <- res$idx
    sk <- add_link(sk, idx_pre_map, idx_correct, reads_correctly_mapped, col_correct,
                   sprintf("Correctly mapped: %s", fmt(reads_correctly_mapped)))
  }
  if (reads_incorrectly_mapped > 0) {
    res <- add_node(sk, sprintf("Incorrectly Mapped\n%s (%s)", fmt(reads_incorrectly_mapped), pct(reads_incorrectly_mapped, pre_map_count)), col_incorrect)
    sk <- res$sk; idx_incorrect <- res$idx
    sk <- add_link(sk, idx_pre_map, idx_incorrect, reads_incorrectly_mapped, col_incorrect,
                   sprintf("Incorrectly mapped: %s", fmt(reads_incorrectly_mapped)))
  }
  if (reads_unmapped > 0) {
    res <- add_node(sk, sprintf("Unmapped\n%s (%s)", fmt(reads_unmapped), pct(reads_unmapped, pre_map_count)), col_unmapped)
    sk <- res$sk; idx_unmapped2 <- res$idx
    sk <- add_link(sk, idx_pre_map, idx_unmapped2, reads_unmapped, col_unmapped,
                   sprintf("Unmapped: %s", fmt(reads_unmapped)))
  }

  render_sankey(sk, height = 380)
}

## Confusion Matrix

```{r confusion-matrix, fig.height=4.5}
include_distractor <- (summary_df$fp_distractor_count > 0 | summary_df$tn_distractor_count > 0)

actual_levels <- c("Sample", "Non-sample Target")
actual_vec <- rep(c("Sample", "Non-sample Target"), each = 2)
predicted_vec <- rep(c("Detected", "Not Detected"), 2)
count_vec <- c(summary_df$tp_count, summary_df$fn_count,
               summary_df$fp_target_count, summary_df$tn_target_count)
label_vec <- c("TP", "FN", "FP_target", "TN_target")

if (include_distractor) {
  actual_levels <- c(actual_levels, "Distractor")
  actual_vec <- c(actual_vec, "Distractor", "Distractor")
  predicted_vec <- c(predicted_vec, "Detected", "Not Detected")
  count_vec <- c(count_vec, summary_df$fp_distractor_count, summary_df$tn_distractor_count)
  label_vec <- c(label_vec, "FP_distractor", "TN_distractor")
}

cm_data <- data.frame(
  actual = factor(actual_vec, levels = actual_levels),
  predicted = factor(predicted_vec, levels = c("Detected", "Not Detected")),
  count = count_vec,
  label = label_vec
)

ggplot(cm_data, aes(x = predicted, y = actual, fill = count)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 2) +
  geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%s\n%d", label, count)),
            size = 5, fontface = "bold") +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "#ecf0f1", high = "#3498db", guide = "none") +
  labs(x = "Predicted", y = "Actual") +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank())
```


## Detection Performance

```{r metrics-barplot}
metrics_data <- data.frame(
  metric = factor(
    c("Sensitivity", "Specificity", "Precision", "F1 Score"),
    levels = c("Sensitivity", "Specificity", "Precision", "F1 Score")
  ),
  value = c(summary_df$sensitivity, summary_df$specificity,
            summary_df$precision, summary_df$f1_score)
)

metric_colors <- ifelse(metrics_data$value >= 0.9, "#27ae60",
                 ifelse(metrics_data$value >= 0.7, "#f39c12", "#e74c3c"))

ggplot(metrics_data, aes(x = metric, y = value, fill = metric)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.6, fill = metric_colors) +
  geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.1f%%", value * 100)), vjust = -0.5, size = 5) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1.15), labels = scales::percent) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
```



## Detection Detail

```{r detail-table}
if (nrow(detail_df) > 0) {
  display_detail <- detail_df %>%
    arrange(factor(classification,
                   levels = c("TP", "FP_target", "FP_distractor", "UNKNOWN", "FN")),
            desc(reads_assigned)) %>%
    mutate(
      ref_length = format(ref_length, big.mark = ","),
      avg_coverage = sprintf("%.1fX", avg_coverage),
      pct_covered_5x = sprintf("%.1f%%", pct_covered_5x),
      pct_covered_20x = sprintf("%.1f%%", pct_covered_20x)
    )

  col_labels <- c("Reference ID", "Category", "Expected", "Detected",
                   "Fragments Generated", "Fragments Captured", "Reads Assigned",
                   "Classification", "Ref Length", "Avg Coverage",
                   "% \u22655X", "% \u226520X")

  if (nrow(display_detail) > 20) {
    datatable(
      display_detail,
      colnames = col_labels,
      options = list(pageLength = 25, scrollX = TRUE,
                     order = list(list(6, "desc"))),
      rownames = FALSE,
      filter = if (nrow(display_detail) > 50) "top" else "none"
    )
  } else {
    knitr::kable(display_detail, col.names = col_labels, align = "llllrrrllrrr")
  }
} else {
  cat("No detection details available.")
}
```

```{r detection-lollipop, fig.height=max(3, min(nrow(detail_df %>% filter(reads_assigned > 0)), 50) * 0.4)}
detected_only <- detail_df %>% filter(reads_assigned > 0)
n_detected <- nrow(detected_only)

if (n_detected > 0) {
  class_colors <- c("TP" = "#27ae60", "FP_target" = "#e67e22",
                     "FP_distractor" = "#e74c3c", "UNKNOWN" = "#95a5a6")

  # Show top 50 by reads_assigned if too many references
  plot_data_lollipop <- if (n_detected > 50) {
    detected_only %>% slice_max(reads_assigned, n = 50)
  } else {
    detected_only
  }

  p <- ggplot(plot_data_lollipop,
         aes(x = reorder(reference_id, reads_assigned),
             y = reads_assigned, color = classification)) +
    geom_segment(aes(xend = reference_id, y = 0, yend = reads_assigned), linewidth = 1) +
    geom_point(size = if (n_detected <= 20) 4 else 2) +
    scale_color_manual(values = class_colors) +
    coord_flip() +
    labs(x = NULL, y = "Reads Assigned", color = "Classification",
         title = if (n_detected > 50) sprintf("Top 50 of %d Detected References", n_detected)
                 else "Reads per Detected Reference") +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom",
          axis.text.y = element_text(size = if (n_detected <= 20) 10 else 7))

  print(p)
}
```

```{r coverage-overview, eval=has_coverage && show_coverage_overview, fig.height=max(3, ceiling(min(n_detected_refs, 30) / 3) * 2.5), fig.width=10}
detected_refs <- detail_df$reference_id[detail_df$detected == "true"]
ref_intervals <- coverage_intervals %>% filter(reference_id %in% detected_refs)

if (nrow(ref_intervals) > 0) {
  plot_data <- do.call(rbind, lapply(unique(ref_intervals$reference_id), function(rid) {
    expand_intervals(ref_intervals %>% filter(reference_id == rid), max_points = 500)
  }))

  ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = position, y = depth)) +
    geom_area(fill = "#3498db", alpha = 0.4) +
    geom_line(color = "#2c3e50", linewidth = 0.3) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 5, linetype = "dashed", color = "#e67e22", linewidth = 0.3) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 20, linetype = "dashed", color = "#e74c3c", linewidth = 0.3) +
    facet_wrap(~reference_id, scales = "free", ncol = 3) +
    labs(x = "Position", y = "Depth",
         title = "Coverage Profiles",
         subtitle = "Dashed lines: 5X (orange), 20X (red)") +
    theme(strip.text = element_text(size = 8),
          axis.text = element_text(size = 6))
}

```{r coverage-detail-plots, eval=has_coverage, results='asis', fig.width=8, fig.height=3}
if (has_coverage && nrow(coverage_intervals) > 0) {
  detected_refs <- detail_df %>%
    filter(detected == "true", ref_length > 0) %>%
    arrange(desc(avg_coverage))

  max_detail_plots <- 100
  n_detail <- nrow(detected_refs)
  if (n_detail > max_detail_plots) {
    detected_refs <- detected_refs %>% slice_head(n = max_detail_plots)
    cat(sprintf('\n\n*Showing top %d of %d detected references by average coverage.*\n\n',
                max_detail_plots, n_detail))
  }

  for (i in seq_len(nrow(detected_refs))) {
    ref_id <- detected_refs$reference_id[i]
    ref_cov <- detected_refs$avg_coverage[i]
    ref_len <- detected_refs$ref_length[i]
    pct5 <- detected_refs$pct_covered_5x[i]
    pct20 <- detected_refs$pct_covered_20x[i]
    ref_data <- expand_intervals(coverage_intervals %>% filter(reference_id == ref_id))

    if (nrow(ref_data) == 0) next

    cat(sprintf('\n\n<details><summary><strong>%s</strong> &mdash; %.1fX avg, %s bp, %.0f%% &ge;5X, %.0f%% &ge;20X</summary>\n\n',
                ref_id, ref_cov, format(ref_len, big.mark = ","), pct5, pct20))

    p <- ggplot(ref_data, aes(x = position, y = depth)) +
      geom_area(fill = "#3498db", alpha = 0.3) +
      geom_line(color = "#2c3e50", linewidth = 0.4) +
      geom_hline(yintercept = 5, linetype = "dashed", color = "#e67e22", linewidth = 0.5) +
      geom_hline(yintercept = 20, linetype = "dashed", color = "#e74c3c", linewidth = 0.5) +
      annotate("text", x = Inf, y = 5, label = "5X", hjust = 1.2, vjust = -0.5,
               color = "#e67e22", size = 3) +
      annotate("text", x = Inf, y = 20, label = "20X", hjust = 1.2, vjust = -0.5,
               color = "#e74c3c", size = 3) +
      labs(x = "Genome Position", y = "Coverage Depth",
           title = sprintf("Coverage: %s", ref_id),
           subtitle = sprintf("%.1fX avg | %.0f%% \u22655X | %.0f%% \u226520X | %s bp",
                              ref_cov, pct5, pct20, format(ref_len, big.mark = ","))) +
      theme_minimal(base_size = 12)

    print(p)
    cat('\n\n</details>\n\n')
  }
}
```

  Value = c(n_present, n_absent, n_ambiguous),

```{r species-id-plot, eval=has_species_calls, fig.height=if (exists("species_calls")) max(4, nrow(species_calls) * 0.35) else 4}
call_colors <- c("PRESENT" = "#27ae60", "ABSENT" = "#e74c3c", "AMBIGUOUS" = "#f39c12")

sc_plot <- species_calls %>%
  mutate(
    species_id = factor(species_id, levels = rev(species_id[order(call, -total_reads)])),
    call = factor(call, levels = c("PRESENT", "AMBIGUOUS", "ABSENT"))
  )

if (nrow(sc_plot) <= 50) {
  ggplot(sc_plot, aes(x = species_id, y = total_reads, fill = call)) +
    geom_col(width = 0.7) +
    geom_text(aes(label = paste0(unique_detected, "u/", shared_detected, "s")),
              hjust = -0.1, size = 3) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = call_colors, name = "Call") +
    coord_flip() +
    labs(x = NULL, y = "Total Reads",
         title = "Species Identification Calls",
         subtitle = "Labels show unique/shared targets detected") +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom")
} else {
  ggplot(sc_plot, aes(x = call, fill = call)) +
    geom_bar(width = 0.7) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = call_colors, name = "Call") +
    labs(x = "Call", y = "Number of Species",
         title = "Species Identification Summary") +
    theme(legend.position = "none")
}
